society.skycraft.rep.enemy: %s now consider you an enemy. Watch your back.
society.skycraft.cosmetic.not_member: Only members of that faction may wear its regalia.
society.skycraft.screen.title: Reputation
society.skycraft.screen.no_regalia: Regalia: join a faction to wear its colors
society.skycraft.screen.regalia_hint: Wear your faction's colors over your own clothes. Everyone sees them.
society.skycraft.charity: Gift of Charity: the beggar's blessing goes with you.
society.skycraft.bark.guard.generic.0: Keep your hands where I can see them.
society.skycraft.bark.guard.generic.2: Watch yourself. These roads aren't as safe as they used to be.
society.skycraft.bark.guard.generic.3: Keep moving. Standing about makes the captain nervous.
society.skycraft.bark.guard.generic.5: I'm watching, you know. It's the whole job.
society.skycraft.bark.guard.generic.6: Another quiet day. I hate quiet days.
society.skycraft.bark.guard.generic.7: Got a complaint? Take it up with the Jarl.
society.skycraft.bark.guard.generic.8: Everything's in order. Keep it that way.
society.skycraft.bark.guard.generic.9: I walked the barrows once, same as you. Then a bad fall down a burial shaft sent me home with a limp and a guard's wage.
society.skycraft.bark.guard.generic.10: If this is about missing pastries again, I'm not interested.
society.skycraft.bark.guard.generic.11: The law's the only thing between this town and the wolves. Mind it.
society.skycraft.bark.guard.generic.12: I hear you've got a silver tongue. Don't waste it on me.
society.skycraft.bark.guard.generic.13: What now? Bandits? Giants? Something with wings?
society.skycraft.bark.guard.night.0: Late to be out walking, isn't it?
society.skycraft.bark.guard.night.1: Stay near the torches after dark.
society.skycraft.bark.guard.night.2: Can't sleep? Neither can the wolves.
society.skycraft.bark.guard.weapon.0: Put that away before you hurt someone.
society.skycraft.bark.guard.weapon.1: Steel out in town? Sheathe it. Now.
society.skycraft.bark.guard.weapon.2: You planning on using that? Because I'd reconsider.
society.skycraft.bark.guard.sneak.1: I can hear you creeping, you know.
society.skycraft.bark.guard.sneak.2: Stand up straight. Honest folk don't skulk.
society.skycraft.bark.guard.wanted.2: I know your face. There's a bounty on your head.
society.skycraft.bark.guard.hero.0: They say you've slain a dragon... is it true?
society.skycraft.bark.guard.hero.1: Walk with honor, champion. The hold owes you.
society.skycraft.bark.guard.hero.2: When the songs are written, I hope they mention I stood watch beside you.
society.skycraft.bark.guard.liked.0: Good to see you, friend. The hold sleeps easier with you around.
society.skycraft.bark.guard.disliked.0: I'm watching you. One wrong step...
society.skycraft.bark.guard.disliked.1: Folk talk about you, and none of it good.
society.skycraft.bark.guard.disliked.2: Make it quick and be on your way.
society.skycraft.bark.town.generic.2: Can I help you with something?
society.skycraft.bark.town.generic.3: The roads have been busy lately.
society.skycraft.bark.town.generic.5: Don't stand there gawking. Some of us have work to do.
society.skycraft.bark.town.generic.6: Gods, I could use a drink.
society.skycraft.bark.town.generic.7: Ever been to the capital? Neither have I.
society.skycraft.bark.town.morning.0: Morning. Bread's fresh if you hurry.
society.skycraft.bark.town.morning.1: Up with the sun, are we?
society.skycraft.bark.town.night.2: I keep hearing howling past the walls.
society.skycraft.bark.town.rain.2: My roof leaks every time it does this.
society.skycraft.bark.town.snow.0: Cold enough to freeze a troll's toes.
society.skycraft.bark.town.snow.1: Keep warm, friend. This snow won't let up.
society.skycraft.bark.town.weapon.2: You're making people nervous with that thing.
society.skycraft.bark.town.wanted.0: That's the one the guards are after!
society.skycraft.bark.town.hero.0: They say you've slain a dragon... is it true?
society.skycraft.bark.town.hero.1: It's you! The one from the stories!
society.skycraft.bark.town.hero.2: My son won't stop talking about you.
society.skycraft.bark.town.liked.0: Ah, my favorite customer... er, neighbor!
society.skycraft.bark.town.liked.1: Always a pleasure to see you around.
society.skycraft.bark.town.liked.2: You're welcome at my table any time.
society.skycraft.bark.town.disliked.0: I've nothing to say to you.
society.skycraft.bark.town.disliked.2: Some people should learn to stay away.
society.skycraft.bark.merchant.generic.2: Best goods in the hold, I promise you.
society.skycraft.bark.merchant.liked.0: For you, my friend, the good stock comes out.
society.skycraft.bark.merchant.liked.1: Ah, my best customer! What can I get you?
society.skycraft.bark.merchant.liked.2: You've done right by this town. Let me show you what I've been saving.
society.skycraft.bark.faction.companions: Is that a Companion? Jorrvaskr's finest.
You run with the Companions? Good. We need strong arms.
society.skycraft.bark.faction.college.0: A mage from the College? Keep your sparks to yourself.
society.skycraft.bark.faction.college.1: Winterhold, eh? Don't go blowing anything up.
society.skycraft.bark.faction.thieves_gu: Watch your purse... there's a Guild type around.
I know that look. The Guild sends its regards, I suppose.
society.skycraft.bark.faction.imperial_l: A soldier of the Legion. Glad you're on the road.
For the Empire, eh? Some round here won't thank you.
society.skycraft.bark.faction.stormcloak: Skyrim belongs to the Nords! Good to see a true son... or daughter.
Ulfric's cause has a friend in you, I see.
society.skycraft.bark.faction.bards_coll: A bard! Sing us something, would you?
From the Bards College? Mind you don't rhyme at me.
society.skycraft.bark.role.hunter.2: A good bow and a steady hand. That's all I need.
society.skycraft.bark.role.miner.0: There's ore in these hills, I can smell it.
society.skycraft.bark.role.miner.1: Back's killing me. Same as every day.
society.skycraft.bark.role.miner.2: Iron today, silver tomorrow, gods willing.
society.skycraft.bark.role.lumberjack.1: This wood'll keep a family warm all winter.
society.skycraft.bark.role.lumberjack.2: Chop, stack, repeat. It's honest work.
society.skycraft.bark.role.bard.0: Have you heard the one about the dragon and the goat?
society.skycraft.bark.role.bard.1: Every hero needs a song. What's yours?
society.skycraft.bark.role.bard.2: Music soothes the savage troll. Mostly.
society.skycraft.bark.role.priest.1: May the Divines watch over you.
society.skycraft.bark.role.priest.2: Mara's love is for everyone, traveler.
society.skycraft.bark.role.priest.3: Light a candle for the departed, if you can spare one.
society.skycraft.bark.role.beggar.1: Please, a septim for an old soldier?
society.skycraft.bark.role.beggar.2: Gods bless you, whoever you are. Even if you've nothing.
society.skycraft.bark.role.mage.2: The College would pay well for what's in these ruins.
society.skycraft.bark.role.adventurer.0: I used to stay home. Then I got bored.
society.skycraft.bark.role.adventurer.1: Barrows are full of draugr and treasure. Mostly draugr.
society.skycraft.bark.role.thalmor.1: Talos is no god. Remember that.
society.skycraft.bark.role.thalmor.2: Move along. This does not concern you.
society.skycraft.bark.role.imperial_sold: The Legion keeps these roads open. You're welcome.
society.skycraft.bark.role.stormcloak_so: The Empire's days here are numbered.
society.skycraft.bark.role.necromancer.1: The dead make such obedient servants.
society.skycraft.bark.role.assassin.1: Nice evening for a walk, isn't it?
society.skycraft.bark.role.courier.0: Letters, packages, the odd threatening note.
society.skycraft.bark.role.courier.1: Never stop moving, that's the courier's way.
society.skycraft.bark.role.innkeeper.0: Rooms are clean, the mead is cold.
society.skycraft.bark.role.innkeeper.1: Need a bed for the night?
society.skycraft.bark.role.innkeeper.2: Pull up a chair, the hearth's warm.
society.skycraft.bark.role.jarl.1: Speak quickly, I have a hold to run.
society.skycraft.bark.role.jarl.2: The people come first. Most days.
society.skycraft.bark.role.housecarl.0: I am sworn to protect the Jarl.
society.skycraft.bark.role.housecarl.1: Touch the Jarl and you answer to me.
society.skycraft.bark.role.thief.1: Whatever you heard, it wasn't me.
society.skycraft.bark.prisoner.1: They're taking me to the block. I've done nothing!
society.skycraft.bark.prisoner.2: If you've got a blade, now's the time.
society.skycraft.bark.attack.thalmor.0: In the name of the Aldmeri Dominion, you are under arrest for heresy!
society.skycraft.bark.attack.thalmor.2: The Aldmeri Dominion sends its regards.
society.skycraft.bark.attack.stormcloak_: Imperial dog! Skyrim belongs to the Nords!
society.skycraft.bark.attack.forsworn.1: Your blood will feed the briar!
society.skycraft.bark.attack.assassin.0: Your death has been bought and paid for.
society.skycraft.bark.attack.assassin.1: The Night Mother sends her regards.
society.skycraft.bark.attack.thug.0: Somebody's tired of you breathing. They paid well to fix that.
society.skycraft.bark.attack.thug.2: Somebody wants you dead, and I'm happy to oblige.
Another one for the bounty board!
society.skycraft.bark.priest_heal.1: Be healed, child of the Divines.
society.skycraft.bark.courier_arrive.0: There you are! Been chasing you across half the hold. This is for you, and nobody else.
society.skycraft.bark.courier_bye.1: Off I go. Plenty more letters to deliver.
society.skycraft.bark.prisoner_freed.0: I'm free! The Divines bless you!
society.skycraft.bark.cart.0: Blasted wheel's cracked clean through... While I wait, care to buy something?
society.skycraft.bark.cart.1: Stuck out here with a broken cart. Fancy a look at my goods?
society.skycraft.bark.guard_chase.1: Halt, thief! In the name of the Jarl!
society.skycraft.bark.escort.1: Nothing to see here, citizen. Prisoner transport.
society.skycraft.greet.hunter.0: Quietly now, you'll spook the game.
society.skycraft.greet.hunter.1: Need meat, pelts? I've plenty of both.
society.skycraft.greet.miner.0: Mind your step, the ground's loose here.
society.skycraft.greet.miner.1: Looking for work? The mine always needs hands.
society.skycraft.greet.lumberjack.0: Careful, trees fall where they please.
society.skycraft.greet.lumberjack.1: Ah, a visitor. Here to buy firewood?
society.skycraft.greet.bard.0: Ah, an audience! What will it be?
society.skycraft.greet.bard.1: Every hall needs a song, and every song needs a listener.
society.skycraft.greet.priest.0: Welcome, child. The Divines see all who come here.
society.skycraft.greet.priest.1: Do you seek healing, or counsel?
society.skycraft.greet.beggar.0: Spare a coin? Just one, friend?
society.skycraft.greet.mage.0: Mind the wards. And don't touch my reagents.
society.skycraft.greet.mage.1: You have the look of someone who's seen strange things.
society.skycraft.greet.adventurer.0: Fellow traveler! Seen any good ruins?
society.skycraft.greet.adventurer.1: Careful out there. Draugr don't sleep as soundly as you'd think.
Keep your nose clean and we'll get along.
society.skycraft.greet.stormcloak_soldie: Speak, friend. These are hard times for true Nords.
society.skycraft.greet.forsworn.0: You walk where you are not welcome.
society.skycraft.greet.vampire.0: What brings you out at this hour?
society.skycraft.greet.necromancer.1: Leave, before you join my collection.
society.skycraft.greet.assassin.0: Have we met? I'm sure I'd remember.
society.skycraft.greet.courier.0: Letters for everyone but me, it seems.
society.skycraft.greet.courier.1: Sorry, nothing for you today. Or is there?
society.skycraft.greet.innkeeper.0: Welcome! Warm fire, cold mead, soft bed.
society.skycraft.greet.innkeeper.1: Come in, come in. What'll it be?
society.skycraft.greet.jarl.0: You stand before the Jarl. Speak.
society.skycraft.greet.jarl.1: What business brings you before me?
society.skycraft.greet.housecarl.0: State your business with the Jarl.
society.skycraft.greet.thief.1: Keep your voice down, will you?
society.skycraft.greet.prisoner: Please, free me! They mean to execute me for nothing!
society.skycraft.greet.cold: I've heard what you've done. Say your piece and leave.
society.skycraft.greet.jarl_honored: Ah, my friend! The hold is in your debt. What can I do for you?
society.skycraft.greet.thalmor: The Thalmor have business here. What do you want?
society.skycraft.say.job.hunter: I track elk and deer, sell the meat in town and the hides to the tanner. Good living, if your aim is true.
society.skycraft.say.job.miner: I break rock for a living. Iron mostly, silver when the gods smile. It's hard work, but it pays.
society.skycraft.say.job.lumberjack: I fell trees and haul them to the mill. Half the houses in the hold are built from my timber.
society.skycraft.say.job.bard: I keep the old songs alive. The Dragonborn, Ysgramor, the fall of the Dwemer... someone has to remember.
society.skycraft.say.job.priest: I tend the shrine and the sick. If you're hurt, I can help. The Divines ask nothing but kindness in return.
society.skycraft.say.job.beggar: Job? Ha. I used to work the farms, until my back gave out. Now I take what kindness I can get.
society.skycraft.say.job.mage: I study the arcane. The College sends some of us out to collect artifacts... and to keep away from the townsfolk.
society.skycraft.say.job.adventurer: Ruins, barrows, caves. If there's treasure at the bottom and something nasty guarding it, I'm interested.
society.skycraft.say.job.thalmor: The Aldmeri Dominion upholds the White-Gold Concordat. Worshipping Talos is against the law. We enforce the law.
society.skycraft.say.job.imperial_soldie: I serve the Legion. We keep the roads safe and the rebels in line. Someone has to.
society.skycraft.say.job.stormcloak_sold: I fight for Ulfric and a free Skyrim. No more Thalmor telling us which gods we may pray to.
society.skycraft.say.job.forsworn: The Reach was ours before the Nords came. We will take it back, one throat at a time.
society.skycraft.say.job.vampire: I'm a... traveler. I keep odd hours.
society.skycraft.say.job.necromancer: I study what lies beyond death. The Mages of the College are too squeamish to learn it.
society.skycraft.say.job.thug: I get paid to make problems go away. Usually with my fists.
society.skycraft.say.job.courier: I carry letters all across Skyrim. Jarls, merchants, the odd love letter. Never read them, mind you.
society.skycraft.say.job.innkeeper: I run the inn. Rooms, meals, mead, and all the gossip in the hold.
society.skycraft.say.job.jarl: I rule this hold. Its people, its guards and its troubles are mine to see to.
society.skycraft.say.job.housecarl: I am sworn to the Jarl. I carry their burdens and guard their life with mine.
society.skycraft.say.coin: Bless you! A septim's a feast for the likes of me.
society.skycraft.say.heal: There. Arkay's light mends what it can. Go carefully.
society.skycraft.say.drink: One mead, coming right up. Brewed just down the road.
society.skycraft.say.war.imperial_soldie: Ulfric's rebellion has split the land in two. The Legion will hold it together, whatever it costs.
We've pushed the Stormcloaks back from the border forts. For now.
society.skycraft.say.war.stormcloak_sold: The Empire sold us out to the elves. Ulfric will set things right.
We took another Imperial outpost last week. Every victory brings us closer to Solitude.
society.skycraft.say.game.0: Deer down by the river at dawn, elk up on the ridge. Stay clear of the sabre cats.
society.skycraft.say.game.1: Wolves have been thick this season. Something's driving them down from the mountains.
society.skycraft.say.standing.hated: You dare show your face in my hall? Every soul in this hold curses your name.
society.skycraft.say.standing.hostile: My people fear you. Give me one reason not to have you thrown out.
society.skycraft.say.standing.disliked: I've heard troubling things about you. Tread carefully in my hold.
society.skycraft.say.standing.neutral: I don't know you, stranger. Do some good here and that may change.
society.skycraft.say.standing.liked: The people speak well of you. You're welcome here.
society.skycraft.say.standing.honored: You've done much for this hold. My doors are always open to you.
society.skycraft.say.standing.revered: There is no one in this hold more beloved than you. Name it, and it is yours.
society.skycraft.say.freed: Thank you! I owe you my life. Now I have to run!
dialogue.skycraft.society.job: What do you do around here?
dialogue.skycraft.society.standing: What do the people think of me?
society.skycraft.letter.inheritance.page:
To %1$s,

It is my sad duty to inform you that a distant relative of yours has passed into Aetherius. Their will names you as heir.

Enclosed you will find the sum of %3$s septims, all that remained of the estate after the debts were settled.

With respect,
%2$s
society.skycraft.letter.invitation.title: A Jarl's Invitation
%1$s,

Tales of your deeds have reached my hall. A hold can always use someone of your talents.

Should your road bring you near, present yourself at my court. There may be work for you, and reward to match.

- %2$s
society.skycraft.letter.warning.title: An Anonymous Warning
society.skycraft.letter.warning.page.0:
Friend,

You don't know me, but I know of you. You have made powerful enemies, and they have begun to hire blades.
society.skycraft.letter.warning.page.1:
Watch the roads. Don't sleep in the open. And whatever you do, don't trust strangers who come asking your name.

- A friend
society.skycraft.letter.thanks.title: A Note of Thanks
society.skycraft.letter.thanks.page.0:
%1$s,

You may not remember me, but you helped me when I was in trouble on the road. I never got the chance to thank you. So: thank you. May the Nine keep you.

- %2$s
society.skycraft.letter.college.title: From the College of Winterhold
society.skycraft.letter.college.page.0:
%1$s,

The College of Winterhold has taken note of your talents. Few show such promise, and fewer still have the will to master it.
society.skycraft.letter.college.page.1:
Should you wish to study the arcane arts, our doors are open to you. Seek out the College in the far north.

- %2$s, on behalf of the Arch-Mage
society.skycraft.letter.map.title: A Crude Map
society.skycraft.letter.map.page.0:
%1$s,

My brother used this map before he went missing. He swore there was a fortune buried in an old barrow in these parts.
society.skycraft.letter.map.page.1:
I'm too old for barrows. You look like you're not. If you find it, light a candle for him.

- %2$s
command.skycraft.society.encounter_faile: No encounter could be placed here right now.
command.skycraft.society.squad_failed: No hit squad could be sent (peaceful, creative, not in the overworld, or no room nearby).
society.skycraft.bark.town.rumor: I hear strange rumors from %s. Might be worth checking out.
dialogue.skycraft.society.rumor_persuade: Heard any rumors about interesting places? [Persuade]
dialogue.skycraft.society.rumor_intimida: Tell me what you know about the area, now! [Intimidate]
society.skycraft.rumor.revealed: I hear there are strange happenings near %s. Might be worth looking into.
society.skycraft.rumor.revealed_fear: Alright, alright! Don't hurt me! They say something dangerous stirred up at %s!
society.skycraft.rumor.none: Nothing new around here, traveler. The roads are quiet.
society.skycraft.rumor.none_fear: I don't know anything, I swear!
society.skycraft.say.intimidate_refuse: You don't scare me. Get lost before I call the guards.
dialogue.skycraft.follower.trade: I need to trade some things with you.
dialogue.skycraft.follower.dismiss: It's time for us to part ways.
dialogue.skycraft.follower.hire: I'm looking for a sellsword. (%s Septims)
dialogue.skycraft.follower.persuade: I could use a warrior like you on the road. [Persuade]
dialogue.skycraft.follower.housecarl: As Thane, I require your assistance.
dialogue.skycraft.follower.friend: Would you journey with me, friend?
society.skycraft.say.follower_dismiss: I'll head back home then. Call on me if you need me.
society.skycraft.say.follower_accept: Lead on. My blade is yours.
society.skycraft.say.follower_refuse: I'm not interested in traveling with you.
society.skycraft.say.housecarl_accept: Honor to you, my Thane. I am sworn to carry your burdens.
society.skycraft.greet.farmer.0: Mind the rows, the shoots are tender this time of year.
society.skycraft.greet.farmer.1: If you've come to buy, the cabbages are good. If you've come to help, the hoe's over there.
society.skycraft.greet.blacksmith.0: Steel's hot and the day is young. What do you need?
society.skycraft.greet.blacksmith.1: If it's dented, I can straighten it. If it's broken, I can make you a new one.
society.skycraft.greet.merchant.0: Come in, come in. Everything's priced fair, more or less.
society.skycraft.greet.merchant.1: Looking to buy, or looking to sell? Either way, I'm listening.
society.skycraft.greet.apothecary.0: Careful where you put your hands. Half these jars bite.
society.skycraft.greet.apothecary.1: Ailing? Curious? I have a remedy for both.
society.skycraft.greet.fisher.0: Fish are biting, if you're the patient sort.
society.skycraft.greet.fisher.1: Smell of the catch puts some folk off. Not you, I hope.
society.skycraft.greet.butcher.0: Fresh cuts today. Yesterday's are cheaper.
society.skycraft.greet.butcher.1: Don't mind the blood. Comes with the trade.
society.skycraft.greet.scholar.0: Ah. A visitor. Do you read, by any chance?
society.skycraft.greet.scholar.1: Mind the stacks. They're in an order, even if it doesn't look like one.
society.skycraft.greet.steward.0: The Jarl's time is precious, and so is mine. What is it?
society.skycraft.greet.steward.1: If this concerns the hold's business, you may speak to me.
society.skycraft.greet.caravan_trader.0: Wares from far away, for a friend who walks the roads.
society.skycraft.greet.caravan_trader.1: Come, look. Every road brings something new to the caravan.
society.skycraft.greet.citizen.0: Afternoon. Haven't seen you around here before.
society.skycraft.greet.citizen.1: Hello there. Need directions, or just passing through?
society.skycraft.greet.child.0: Wanna race? I'm the fastest in town!
society.skycraft.greet.child.1: My papa says the roads are dangerous. Are they?
society.skycraft.greet.spouse.0: There you are, %s. I was beginning to worry.
society.skycraft.greet.spouse.2: Back from the road? Sit, rest, tell me everything.
society.skycraft.greet.spouse.3: My heart lifts every time you walk through that door.
society.skycraft.greet.child.2: I found a shiny rock! Don't tell anyone.
society.skycraft.greet.friend.0: %s! Good to see a friendly face.
society.skycraft.greet.friend.1: Well, if it isn't my favourite traveler.
society.skycraft.greet.friend.2: Ah, it's you. Pull up a seat, friend.
society.skycraft.greet.friend.3: Always glad when you come by, %s.
society.skycraft.greet.khajiit.0: Khajiit greets you, walker. The sands were kind to bring you here.
society.skycraft.greet.khajiit.1: This one is pleased to see a new face. Is it a generous face?
society.skycraft.greet.khajiit.2: Ah, %s. Khajiit has been hoping you would come.
society.skycraft.greet.khajiit.3: Warm are the days when friends visit this one.
society.skycraft.greet.argonian.0: The waters guided you here. What do you need?
society.skycraft.greet.argonian.1: Speak plainly. This one's scales itch in this cold.
society.skycraft.greet.argonian.2: Greetings, warmblood. Even the Hist would find this weather harsh.
society.skycraft.greet.dunmer.0: Another outlander. What do you want?
society.skycraft.greet.dunmer.1: If you're here to stare, take a good look and be done with it.
society.skycraft.greet.dunmer.2: Speak, then. I haven't got all day, and neither have you.
society.skycraft.greet.orc.0: Hah. You look like you can swing an axe. Good.
society.skycraft.greet.orc.1: Speak your piece. Orcs don't waste words.
society.skycraft.say.job.farmer: I work the fields from first light. Cabbage, leeks, potatoes, wheat when the summer allows. The hold eats because people like me don't sleep in.
society.skycraft.say.job.blacksmith: I keep the forge burning. Swords for the guard, nails for the carpenter, hinges for the tavern door. Anything iron in this town, I've had my hands on.
society.skycraft.say.job.merchant: I buy, I sell, I keep the ledgers honest. Mostly honest. A little of everything passes through my shop.
society.skycraft.say.job.apothecary: I brew potions and sell ingredients. Cures for the sick, tonics for the tired, and the odd thing I don't ask about.
society.skycraft.say.job.fisher: I fish. Morning, evening, sometimes in between. The water gives, and I sell what it gives.
society.skycraft.say.job.butcher: I cut meat and sell it fresh. Hunters bring me the game, I make it fit for a table.
society.skycraft.say.job.scholar: I study. History, mostly, and the odd text on the arcane. Somebody has to remember what everyone else forgets.
society.skycraft.say.job.steward: I manage the hold's affairs on the Jarl's behalf: the treasury, the granaries, the deeds to every house within these walls.
society.skycraft.say.job.caravan_trader: This one travels with the caravan, from the warm south to the cold north. We trade what others cannot find.
society.skycraft.say.job.citizen: Me? I get by. A little work here, a little there. Somebody has to keep this town running between all the important folk.
society.skycraft.say.job.child: I help my ma with the chores. Mostly I hide from the chores.
society.skycraft.say.origin.nord: My family has worked this land since before the Empire drew its maps. Skyrim is in the blood.
society.skycraft.say.origin.imperial: My grandparents came up from Cyrodiil with the Legion and never left. I've more snow in my bones than sun now.
society.skycraft.say.origin.breton: My people are from High Rock, past the mountains to the west. Some say we've a bit of elf in us. I say we've good sense.
society.skycraft.say.origin.redguard: My family crossed the Alik'r to get here. Hammerfell is all sand and pride. I took the pride and left the sand.
society.skycraft.say.origin.altmer: I'm from the Summerset Isles. And no, before you ask, I have nothing to do with the Thalmor.
society.skycraft.say.origin.bosmer: I grew up beneath the great trees of Valenwood. Your forests here are pretty, but they don't walk.
society.skycraft.say.origin.dunmer: My family fled Morrowind when the mountain burned. We've been unwelcome guests ever since.
society.skycraft.say.origin.khajiit: Khajiit comes from Elsweyr, land of sugar and sand. This one misses the warmth, but not the politics.
society.skycraft.say.origin.argonian: I hatched in Black Marsh, under the Hist. It is wet there, and warm, and nobody asks me to explain myself.
society.skycraft.say.origin.orc: I was born in a stronghold in the mountains. Left when I wanted more than the chief's leftovers.
society.skycraft.say.hold.0: The treasury is thin and the walls need mending. Every hold has its troubles; ours are just louder.
society.skycraft.say.hold.1: Grain stores are full this year, gods be thanked. The Jarl means to keep them that way.
society.skycraft.say.hold.2: Bandits on the roads, wolves in the hills, petitioners at the door. A steward's work is never done.
society.skycraft.say.harvest.0: Good, if the frost holds off another fortnight. Bad, if it doesn't.
society.skycraft.say.harvest.1: Mudcrabs got into the leeks again. Cheeky things.
society.skycraft.say.harvest.2: Every year the soil gives a bit less and the Jarl wants a bit more. Still, we eat.
society.skycraft.say.smithing.0: Heat the steel slow and quench it fast. Rush either and you'll have a pretty sword that snaps on the first blow.
society.skycraft.say.smithing.1: Leather wraps on the grip. Nobody thinks about the grip until their hand slips.
society.skycraft.say.smithing.2: Iron's honest. Steel's better. Anything fancier and you're paying for the name.
society.skycraft.say.business.0: Trade's slow with the roads the way they are. Caravans don't come through as often.
society.skycraft.say.business.1: I'll buy what you bring, if it's worth anything. Just don't bring me anything with blood still on it.
society.skycraft.say.business.2: Prices go up every time someone mentions dragons. Funny how that works.
society.skycraft.say.caravan.0: The caravan goes where the coin goes. Lately, that is everywhere and nowhere.
society.skycraft.say.caravan.1: Some cities do not let Khajiit inside their walls. So the walls come to us, to buy.
society.skycraft.say.caravan.2: Moon sugar? This one has never heard of it. Perhaps you are thinking of a different caravan.
society.skycraft.say.fishing.0: Dawn's the best time. Fish are hungry and the guards are asleep.
society.skycraft.say.fishing.1: Slaughterfish in the deeper pools. Keep your toes out of the water.
society.skycraft.say.studies.0: Did you know the old Nordic tombs were built to keep the dead in, not the living out? Comforting, isn't it.
society.skycraft.say.studies.1: I'm cataloguing the hold's ruins. Every second one is full of draugr. The other half are full of worse.
society.skycraft.say.studies.2: The Dwemer vanished all at once, cities and all. Nobody knows how. That's what keeps me up at night.
society.skycraft.say.play.0: You're it! No, wait, I'm it. Run!
society.skycraft.say.play.1: Let's play hide and seek. You count, I hide. Count to a hundred!
society.skycraft.say.play.2: I'll play later. Ma says I have to stay where she can see me.
society.skycraft.say.play.3: Can you show me how to swing a sword? Just once?
society.skycraft.say.song_named: Ah, a request! Then let me give you "%s". Gather round...
society.skycraft.say.region.haafingar: Haafingar, seat of the High King's city on its great stone arch over the sea. The Empire's eyes are everywhere here, and its ships too.
society.skycraft.say.region.hjaalmarch: Hjaalmarch is all marsh and mist. Folk keep to themselves, and they keep their doors shut after dark. With good reason.
society.skycraft.say.region.the_pale: The Pale. Snow nine months of the year, and the miners say the other three are worse. Hard land breeds hard people.
society.skycraft.say.region.winterhold: Winterhold was a great city once, before the sea took half of it. Now there's the College on its rock, and not much else.
society.skycraft.say.region.the_reach: The Reach is all crags and silver mines. Watch the hills: the Forsworn never forgave anyone for taking them.
society.skycraft.say.region.whiterun: Whiterun hold sits in the middle of everything. Plains, farms, the mountain to the east. Every road in Skyrim runs through here eventually.
society.skycraft.say.region.eastmarch: Eastmarch: hot springs, cold stone, and a city that remembers every grudge. Ash drifts down from the east when the wind turns.
society.skycraft.say.region.falkreath: Falkreath has more graves than living folk, they say. The forests are deep and old, and the dead rest easy in them. Mostly.
society.skycraft.say.region.the_rift: The Rift. Golden trees, quiet lakes, and a city where every coin changes hands twice before breakfast.
society.skycraft.say.region.solstheim: Solstheim belongs to Morrowind now, for what it's worth. Ash on the wind, and the old Nord stones humming in the north.
society.skycraft.say.region.unknown: Strange country, this. I'm not sure anyone has ever properly mapped it.
society.skycraft.say.province.skyrim: Skyrim, land of the Nords. Cold, proud and stubborn as a mountain goat, and twice as hard to move.
society.skycraft.say.province.cyrodiil: Cyrodiil, heartland of the Empire. Roads, taxes and legionaries as far as the eye can see.
society.skycraft.say.province.morrowind: Morrowind. Ash, mushroom forests and Great Houses who'd sooner duel than share a road.
society.skycraft.say.province.black_mars: Black Marsh. Warm rain, deep water, and trees older than any kingdom. Don't drink the water. Don't eat the plants.
society.skycraft.say.province.elsweyr: Elsweyr: badlands in the north, jungle in the south, and the moons over all of it.
society.skycraft.say.province.valenwood: Valenwood, where the trees are towns and the towns sometimes get up and walk away.
society.skycraft.say.province.summerset: The Summerset Isles. Every stone in place, every flower trimmed, every visitor watched.
society.skycraft.say.province.hammerfell: Hammerfell. Sword-singers, sun and sand. Its people would rather die than kneel, and sometimes do.
society.skycraft.say.province.high_rock: High Rock: a hundred little kingdoms, a thousand little feuds, and very good wine.
society.skycraft.say.province.atmora: Atmora, the old land. Ice as far as you can see, and the bones of the first Nords beneath it.
society.skycraft.say.province.akavir: Akavir. The far east. Even the maps there are only guesses.
society.skycraft.say.province.yokuda: Yokuda, the sunken homeland of the Redguards. What the sea left is all sun-baked stone.
society.skycraft.say.news.place.0: Heard tell of something going on at %1$s, %2$s of here. I'd go armed, if I were you.
society.skycraft.say.news.place.1: A trapper came through talking about %1$s. Off to the %2$s. Said he wouldn't go back for any money.
society.skycraft.say.news.place.2: You know %1$s? %2$s, a fair walk. People say there's treasure there. People say a lot of things.
society.skycraft.say.news.place.3: If you're after trouble, try %1$s, to the %2$s. Trouble seems to like it there.
society.skycraft.say.news.none.0: Nothing new since we last spoke. Same old roads, same old faces.
society.skycraft.say.news.none.1: I've told you all I know, friend.
society.skycraft.say.how.enemy.0: You've got some nerve, talking to me after what you did.
society.skycraft.say.how.disliked.0: I'm fine. Not that it's any of your concern.
society.skycraft.say.how.disliked.1: Can't complain. Well, I could. About you.
society.skycraft.say.how.stranger.0: Well enough, thank you. Can't say I know you, though.
society.skycraft.say.how.acquaintance.0: Not bad, %s. Not bad at all.
society.skycraft.say.how.acquaintance.1: Better now that the work's done. Mostly done.
society.skycraft.say.how.friend.0: Good, now that you're here. Sit a while?
society.skycraft.say.how.friend.1: You always ask, %s. That's more than most do.
society.skycraft.say.how.confidant.0: Honestly? Tired. But I'd tell you if something were really wrong. You know that.
society.skycraft.say.how.confidant.1: Better for having friends like you.
society.skycraft.say.how.ally.0: Whatever you need, %s, you only have to ask. You know that.
society.skycraft.say.how.ally.1: With you watching my back? Never better.
society.skycraft.say.gift.again: You've already been more than generous today. Save something for yourself.
society.skycraft.say.gift.loved: Oh! For me? You remembered what I like. Thank you, truly.
society.skycraft.say.gift.generous: This is too much... but I won't insult you by refusing. Thank you, %s.
society.skycraft.say.gift.trinket: Er... thank you. I'll find somewhere to put it.
society.skycraft.say.gift.thanks: That's kind of you. I won't forget it.
society.skycraft.say.favor.refuse: Help from you? I'd rather manage on my own.
society.skycraft.say.favor.ask.0: Since you're asking: I could use %1$s %2$s. Bring them by and there's %3$s gold in it for you.
society.skycraft.say.favor.ask.1: There is something. I'm short %1$s %2$s. Find me some and I'll pay %3$s gold.
society.skycraft.say.favor.ask.2: Kind of you to offer. %1$s %2$s would see me through the week. I'll make it worth %3$s gold.
society.skycraft.say.favor.done: Just what I needed. Here's your %s gold, and my thanks.
society.skycraft.say.favor.done_poor: Bless you. I've nothing to give back but my thanks. You'll have that always.
society.skycraft.say.mara_about: Mara is the Mother, goddess of love and of the hearth. Wear her amulet and you tell the world you're open to a partner. Those who return the feeling will notice.
society.skycraft.say.mara_no_gold: The amulet asks a donation of two hundred septims to the temple. Come back when you have it.
society.skycraft.say.mara_sold: Wear it in good faith. Mara watches over those who seek a partner honestly.
society.skycraft.say.wed_temple: Then let us go to the temple. %s will speak the words; I'll meet you there.
society.skycraft.say.wed_bring: I'll gladly marry you, but I can't marry one of you. Bring %s here and we'll begin.
society.skycraft.say.propose.refuse.0: That amulet? You're very sweet, but we barely know each other.
society.skycraft.say.propose.refuse.1: I... no. I'm flattered, truly, but no.
society.skycraft.say.propose.refuse.2: Perhaps if I knew you better. Perhaps.
society.skycraft.say.propose.accept_temp: Yes! Gods, yes. Let's go to the temple, I'll meet you before the priest.
I've been hoping you'd ask. Come, the temple isn't far. I'll be waiting.
society.skycraft.say.propose.accept_here: There's no temple near, but Mara hears us anywhere. Let's not wait another day.
society.skycraft.say.newlywed: Mara keep us both. I'm yours, %s.
society.skycraft.say.spouse_moved: Your house? Our house, now. I'll have it in order by the time you're back.
society.skycraft.say.spouse_settled: Here, then. I'll make this place a home.
society.skycraft.say.spouse_follow: Lead on, love. Where you go, I go.
society.skycraft.say.spouse_gold: Here's today's share of the shop's earnings: %s septims. Spend it on something nice.
society.skycraft.say.spouse_gold_home: I managed to set aside %s septims. It's not much, but it's ours.
society.skycraft.say.spouse_meal.0: I made your favourite. Eat while it's hot.
society.skycraft.say.spouse_meal.1: Here, something warm for the road. And come back safe.
society.skycraft.say.spouse_meal.2: I tried a new recipe. If it's terrible, lie to me.
society.skycraft.wedding.title: Wedding
society.skycraft.wedding.0: We gather in Mara's sight to join %1$s and %2$s.
society.skycraft.wedding.1: Love is a road walked together. Will you walk it, through cold and dark and plenty?
society.skycraft.wedding.2: Then let the Divines bear witness: from this day you share hearth, bread and burden.
society.skycraft.wedding.3: By Mara's grace, %1$s and %2$s are wed. Go in love.
society.skycraft.wedding.self.0: Mara, Mother of us all, hear us.
society.skycraft.wedding.self.1: I take you, %1$s, through cold and dark and plenty.
society.skycraft.wedding.self.2: Hearth, bread and burden, from this day shared.
society.skycraft.wedding.self.3: Let the gods witness it. We're wed.
society.skycraft.widowed.title: Widowed
society.skycraft.widowed: %s is dead. The house feels emptier than it should.
society.skycraft.lovers_comfort: Lover's Comfort: a home-cooked meal and a warm farewell lift your spirits.
society.skycraft.say.trespass.wake: Who's there?! You've no business in here!
society.skycraft.say.trespass.warn: Get out of my house, or I'll call the guards!
society.skycraft.say.trespass.guards: Guards! Guards! There's someone in my house!
dialogue.skycraft.society.gift: I have a gift for you. (%s)
dialogue.skycraft.society.favor: Do you need help with anything?
dialogue.skycraft.society.favor_done: I've brought what you asked for. (%s %s)
dialogue.skycraft.society.mara_buy: I'd like an Amulet of Mara. (%s gold)
dialogue.skycraft.society.propose: (Amulet of Mara) Would you have me as your spouse?
dialogue.skycraft.society.spouse_meal: Could you cook something for me?
society.skycraft.song.0.title: The Long Road North
society.skycraft.song.0.0: Out of the south with the wind at my back,
society.skycraft.song.0.1: snow on the pass and the sky turning black,
society.skycraft.song.0.2: Mead in the hall and a fire to keep,
society.skycraft.song.0.3: walk the long road while the old kings sleep.
society.skycraft.song.0.4: Raise up your cup to the friends that we've lost,
society.skycraft.song.0.5: home is the hearth, whatever the cost.
society.skycraft.song.1.title: Ballad of the Iron Shield
society.skycraft.song.1.0: She stood at the gate when the raiders came,
society.skycraft.song.1.1: a shield on her arm and a song for her name,
society.skycraft.song.1.2: They broke on her wall like the sea on the stone,
society.skycraft.song.1.3: she held till the dawn and she held it alone.
society.skycraft.song.1.4: So drink to the shield-maid, her courage, her steel,
society.skycraft.song.1.5: the bards still remember; the raiders still feel.
society.skycraft.song.2.title: Fisherman's Lament
society.skycraft.song.2.0: The nets came up empty, the lake turned to grey,
society.skycraft.song.2.1: my love's on the shore but she's walking away,
society.skycraft.song.2.2: I'll cast once again when the moons have both set,
society.skycraft.song.2.3: for the fish and my sweetheart aren't finished with me yet.
society.skycraft.song.2.4: Oh row, brothers, row, through the cold and the foam,
society.skycraft.song.2.5: a fisherman's heart is a long way from home.
society.skycraft.song.3.title: When the Dragon Woke
society.skycraft.song.3.0: The mountain was quiet a thousand years long,
society.skycraft.song.3.1: till a shadow went over and ended the song,
society.skycraft.song.3.2: The farmers looked up and the soldiers took flight,
society.skycraft.song.3.3: and the sky over Skyrim was burning that night.
society.skycraft.song.3.4: But somewhere a voice that the old tongues obey
society.skycraft.song.3.5: is coming to answer. Is coming our way.
society.skycraft.song.4.title: Sweetroll Saturday
society.skycraft.song.4.0: Oh the baker was baking a hundred and three,
society.skycraft.song.4.1: one for the guard and the rest of them for me,
society.skycraft.song.4.2: Icing and honey and a crust like the sun,
society.skycraft.song.4.3: I'll eat them all slowly, I'll eat them each one.
society.skycraft.song.4.4: So hide them, baker, wherever you will,
society.skycraft.song.4.5: my nose is a hound and I'm hungry still!
society.skycraft.chat.generic.0.1: Like a log. Until the roosters started.
society.skycraft.chat.generic.0.2: Roosters. Should have them in a stew, the lot of them.
society.skycraft.chat.generic.1.0: Did you hear the Jarl's guards caught someone stealing apples?
society.skycraft.chat.generic.1.1: Apples? With everything going on, they're chasing apples?
society.skycraft.chat.generic.1.2: Well, they were very good apples.
society.skycraft.chat.generic.2.1: Stubborn as ever. Says she'll outlive us all.
society.skycraft.chat.generic.3.1: Up half the night with the little one. Teething.
society.skycraft.chat.generic.3.2: Rub a bit of honey on the gums. Works every time.
society.skycraft.chat.generic.4.0: Have you tried the new mead at the inn?
society.skycraft.chat.generic.4.1: Tried it? I had three. Couldn't find my own door.
society.skycraft.chat.generic.4.2: That explains the singing I heard.
society.skycraft.chat.generic.5.0: Someone left the gate open again last night.
society.skycraft.chat.generic.5.1: Wasn't me. I was asleep by dusk.
society.skycraft.chat.generic.5.2: Well, the goat certainly didn't do it.
society.skycraft.chat.generic.6.2: True enough. Back to it, then.
society.skycraft.chat.generic.7.0: They say a traveler came through asking about old ruins.
society.skycraft.chat.generic.7.1: Adventurers. They're always asking about ruins.
society.skycraft.chat.generic.7.2: And never coming back from them, half the time.
society.skycraft.chat.rain.0.1: Good for the crops, I suppose.
society.skycraft.chat.rain.1.0: I can't remember the last time my boots were dry.
society.skycraft.chat.rain.1.1: Stuff them with straw by the fire. Old trick.
society.skycraft.chat.rain.1.2: I'll try anything at this point.
society.skycraft.chat.rain.2.0: Smells like the whole world's been washed.
society.skycraft.chat.rain.2.1: Smells like wet dog, more like.
society.skycraft.chat.snow.0.0: Snow up to my knees on the north road.
society.skycraft.chat.snow.0.1: And it's not even the cold season yet.
society.skycraft.chat.snow.0.2: In Skyrim, every season is the cold season.
society.skycraft.chat.snow.1.0: My fingers have forgotten what warm feels like.
society.skycraft.chat.snow.1.1: Come by the forge. Best fire in town.
society.skycraft.chat.snow.1.2: Might take you up on that.
society.skycraft.chat.snow.2.0: Kids built a snow troll by the well.
society.skycraft.chat.night.0.2: Too quiet's how the stories start. Get inside.
society.skycraft.chat.dragons.0.0: Do you believe the stories? About dragons?
society.skycraft.chat.dragons.0.1: I believe what I see. And I saw something big over the mountains.
society.skycraft.chat.dragons.0.2: Gods help us if it's true.
society.skycraft.chat.dragons.1.0: A dragon burned a farm near the river, they say.
society.skycraft.chat.dragons.1.1: They say a lot of things.
society.skycraft.chat.dragons.1.2: They also said the farm was gone. And it is.
society.skycraft.chat.dragons.2.0: If a dragon comes, what do we do?
society.skycraft.chat.dragons.2.1: Run. Hide. Pray to Talos. Not in that order.
society.skycraft.chat.war.0.0: More soldiers on the road today.
society.skycraft.chat.war.0.1: The war's getting closer, mark my words.
society.skycraft.chat.war.0.2: I just want to plant my fields in peace.
society.skycraft.chat.war.1.0: Who are you for, then? Empire or Stormcloaks?
society.skycraft.chat.war.1.1: I'm for my family eating this winter.
society.skycraft.chat.war.1.2: Smartest answer I've heard all week.
society.skycraft.chat.war.2.0: My cousin joined up last month.
society.skycraft.chat.war.2.2: He hasn't written. I'm afraid to ask.
society.skycraft.chat.jarl.0.0: The Jarl raised the tithe again.
society.skycraft.chat.jarl.1.0: Saw the Jarl ride out this morning.
society.skycraft.chat.prices.0.0: Have you seen what they're asking for salt?
society.skycraft.chat.prices.0.2: I've half a mind to start eating my food bland.
society.skycraft.chat.prices.1.0: Bread costs more than it did last spring.
society.skycraft.chat.family.0.0: My boy wants to be an adventurer.
society.skycraft.chat.family.0.1: Tell him the barrows are full of draugr.
society.skycraft.chat.family.1.0: My sister's getting married at last.
society.skycraft.chat.family.1.1: To the miller's son? About time.
society.skycraft.chat.rumor.0.0: A hunter swore he saw lights at %1$s.
society.skycraft.chat.rumor.0.2: Either way, I'm not going near the place.
society.skycraft.chat.rumor.1.0: My uncle went to %1$s once, looking for treasure.
society.skycraft.chat.rumor.1.2: He found a limp. Never talked about it after.
society.skycraft.chat.rumor.2.2: This time the guards are worried too.
society.skycraft.chat.work_farmer.0.0: Rows are finished, %1$s. Just the east field left.
society.skycraft.chat.work_farmer.0.2: That's why I left it for last.
society.skycraft.chat.work_farmer.1.0: Need another pair of hands at harvest.
society.skycraft.chat.work_farmer.1.2: Your nephew couldn't find a cabbage in a cabbage patch.
The forge is running hot today.
Guard captain wants twenty spearheads by week's end.
Twenty? He'll be lucky to get ten.
Ore's been poor from the mine lately.
More slag than iron, I'd wager.
And they still want full price.
society.skycraft.chat.work_merchant.0.0: Sold the last of the furs this morning.
society.skycraft.chat.work_merchant.0.2: Some traveler. Paid in gold, didn't haggle. Suspicious, really.
society.skycraft.chat.work_merchant.1.2: Or the Khajiit found a better market.
society.skycraft.chat.work_miner.0.0: Found a vein of silver at the bottom shaft.
society.skycraft.chat.work_miner.0.1: Silver! The foreman will be pleased.
society.skycraft.chat.work_miner.0.2: The foreman will take all the credit, you mean.
society.skycraft.chat.work_hunter.0.0: Elk tracks by the river, fresh this morning.
society.skycraft.chat.work_hunter.0.2: Big enough to feed half the town.
society.skycraft.chat.work_fisher.0.0: Slaughterfish took my best line today.
society.skycraft.chat.work_fisher.0.1: Better your line than your hand.
society.skycraft.chat.work_priest.0.0: More folk at the shrine this week.
society.skycraft.chat.work_priest.0.2: Then I hope the Divines are listening.
society.skycraft.chat.work_bard.0.0: I've written a new verse about the old king.
society.skycraft.chat.children.1.0: Want to see a frog I caught?
society.skycraft.chat.children.1.2: Don't tell my ma it's in my pocket.
society.skycraft.chat.children.2.0: When I grow up I'm going to fight a dragon.
society.skycraft.chat.children.2.1: When I grow up I'm going to tame one.
society.skycraft.chat.children.3.0: Bet you can't climb that fence.
society.skycraft.chat.children.3.2: Ma's going to be so cross.
society.skycraft.chat.gossip_skyrim.0.0: They say the Greybeards called someone up the mountain.
society.skycraft.chat.gossip_skyrim.0.1: The Greybeards haven't called anyone in ages.
society.skycraft.chat.gossip_skyrim.1.0: The High King's death still has the holds at each other's throats.
society.skycraft.chat.gossip_skyrim.1.1: Jarls squabbling while the land burns.
society.skycraft.chat.gossip_skyrim.2.0: Giants moved their camp closer to the road.
society.skycraft.chat.gossip_skyrim.2.1: Leave them be and they'll leave you be.
society.skycraft.chat.gossip_skyrim.2.2: Tell that to the farmer who lost his cow.
society.skycraft.chat.gossip_eastmarch.0: Have the wagons for ships, a Company office, Argonian dockhands reached the ancient stone capital yet, %1$s, or did Windhelm is snowbound slow them along the city's long bridge controls the river crossing?
Half the load just cleared the toll-post; in Eastmarch, Kynesgrove, Darkwater Crossing and the Orc mine never stops for bad skies.
Good thing too—without ships, a Company office, Argonian dockhands, half the hearths around the ancient stone capital would go cold before next market day.
society.skycraft.chat.gossip_eastmarch.1: Did you hear the latest decree from Dunmer refugees in a neglected quarter about the Stormcloaks' seat, %1$s?
Everyone in Eastmarch has heard it, and tempers are already fraying over suspicion between Nords and Dunmer.
Let Dunmer refugees in a neglected quarter argue in the ancient stone capital—we still have to keep watch along a high basin of hot springs, fumaroles and sulphur pools.
society.skycraft.chat.gossip_the_reach.0: Have the wagons for the prison mine is the city's wealth reached the stone city in the gorge yet, %1$s, or did mild and damp beside the snowy north slow them along the Karth runs north-east through the hold?

Good thing too—without the prison mine is the city's wealth, half the hearths around the stone city in the gorge would go cold before next market day.

society.skycraft.chat.gossip_haafingar.0: Have the wagons for the East Empire Company's warehouse and ships reached capital and port yet, %1$s, or did fog rolls in off the sea and fills the estuary at dawn slow them along the river meets the sea under the arch; the harbour is the hold's water and wealth?

Good thing too—without the East Empire Company's warehouse and ships, half the hearths around capital and port would go cold before next market day.

Everyone in Haafingar has heard it, and tempers are already fraying over a moot must choose a new High King.
Let rich, Imperial-minded families in manors argue in capital and port—we still have to keep watch along a natural stone arch over the Karth estuary carries the city.

Good thing too—without wheat, cabbage and cattle farms on the flats, half the hearths around the capital at the crossroads would go cold before next market day.

Let Plains (market and commoners), Wind (warriors' hall, temple and family houses), Cloud (the palace and court) argue in the capital at the crossroads—we still have to keep watch along rolling grass tundra with rock outcrops.

Good thing too—without the College's needs keep an inn and a shop alive, half the hearths around a shrunken seat would go cold before next market day.
The Imperial City raised the road toll again.
To pay for the Legion, no doubt.
My cousin in the Heartlands says the harvest was grand.
Lucky them, indeed. Warm weather and fat sheep.
society.skycraft.chat.gossip_morrowind.1: Ash storm coming in from the mountain.
And pray it's just ash this time.
The desert wind's been fierce this week.
Sand in everything. My bread, my boots, my teeth.
society.skycraft.chat.gossip_high_rock.0: Two barons fighting over a bridge, they say.
Another bridge? There's only so many bridges.
society.skycraft.chat.gossip_elsweyr.0.0: The moons were bright last night.
society.skycraft.chat.gossip_elsweyr.0.1: Good night for the young ones to be born, they say.
society.skycraft.chat.gossip_elsweyr.0.2: Every night is a good night for something, in Elsweyr.
society.skycraft.chat.gossip_black_marsh: The water rose again by the roots.
The Hist knows what it's doing.
This one hopes it knows faster.
society.skycraft.chat.gossip_valenwood.0: The walking tree passed by the river this morning.
society.skycraft.chat.gossip_summerset.0: A ship from the mainland arrived today.
Full of outsiders who need watching.
society.skycraft.bark.role.farmer.0: Another day, another row of cabbages.
society.skycraft.bark.role.farmer.1: If the rain holds off, we'll have a fine harvest.
society.skycraft.bark.role.farmer.2: Careful, you're standing on the turnips.
society.skycraft.bark.role.blacksmith.0: Need something sharpened? I'll do it right.
society.skycraft.bark.role.blacksmith.1: Good steel takes time. Bad steel takes longer.
society.skycraft.bark.role.merchant.0: Fine goods, fair prices. Well, prices.
society.skycraft.bark.role.merchant.1: Come take a look, no harm in looking.
society.skycraft.bark.role.merchant.2: Buying or selling? Either way, come in.
society.skycraft.bark.role.apothecary.2: Don't sniff the blue jar. Trust me.
society.skycraft.bark.role.fisher.2: Watch the slaughterfish, they're bold this year.
society.skycraft.bark.role.butcher.1: Venison, mutton, a little horker if you're brave.
society.skycraft.bark.role.scholar.1: Where did I put that book?
society.skycraft.bark.role.scholar.2: History repeats, mostly because nobody reads it.
society.skycraft.bark.role.steward.1: Petitions are heard in the mornings.
society.skycraft.bark.role.caravan_trade: Khajiit's wares are many. Is your purse heavy, friend?
Rare goods from distant lands, friend.
The road is long. Buy something to shorten it.
society.skycraft.bark.role.citizen.1: Have you seen my cat? Grey, fat, answers to nothing.
society.skycraft.bark.role.citizen.2: This town gets busier every year.
society.skycraft.bark.role.citizen.3: Off to the market, then home. Same as every day.
society.skycraft.bark.role.child.3: I'm not allowed past the gate.
society.skycraft.bark.guard.generic.14: My feet hurt, my helmet itches, and my shift's only half over.
society.skycraft.bark.guard.generic.15: Keep out of trouble and we'll get along just fine.
society.skycraft.bark.guard.generic.16: Saw a skeever the size of a dog last night. Don't laugh. It had a helmet.
society.skycraft.bark.guard.generic.17: Every cutpurse in Skyrim thinks he's the clever one. They all end up in the same cell.
society.skycraft.bark.guard.generic.18: If you're looking for adventure, try the barrows. If you're looking for a fight, try me.
society.skycraft.bark.guard.generic.19: I could have been a farmer, you know. My father said I'd be a good farmer.
society.skycraft.bark.guard.generic.20: Patrol, eat, sleep, patrol. The glamorous life.
society.skycraft.bark.guard.generic.21: Nice weather for keeping the peace.
society.skycraft.bark.guard.generic.22: The Jarl pays us to watch. So I watch. You, mostly.
society.skycraft.bark.guard.generic.23: Any trouble on the road? No? Keep it that way.
society.skycraft.bark.guard.generic.24: Don't make me chase you. I hate running in this armor.
society.skycraft.bark.guard.generic.25: They tell me the mead's good at the inn. Wouldn't know. I'm always on duty.
society.skycraft.bark.guard.generic.26: I had a sword like yours, once. Lost it in a bet. Long story.
society.skycraft.bark.guard.generic.27: Wolves, bandits, trolls, and now dragons. What's next, angry mudcrabs?
society.skycraft.bark.guard.generic.28: Mind the cart ruts, traveler. Broke my ankle on one last winter.
society.skycraft.bark.guard.generic.29: Seen anything strange? Besides me, I mean.
society.skycraft.ambush.demand: Your money or your life! %s gold, and be quick about it.
society.skycraft.ambush.hover.pay: Hand over the gold and walk on
society.skycraft.ambush.hover.flee: Run for it: they take a moment to react
society.skycraft.ambush.paid: Pleasure doing business. Off with you.
society.skycraft.ambush.talked: ...Fine. Move along, and keep your mouth shut.
society.skycraft.ambush.fled: You run. They shout after you.
society.skycraft.ambush.none: No one is demanding anything of you.
This one's wares are always for sale, friend. Day or night, the road does not keep shop hours.
Khajiit has traveled far. Khajiit has things you did not know you needed.
Come, come. The caravan rests when the buyer is gone.
society.skycraft.say.traveler.caravan.0: The roads are lean this season. Fewer carts, more bandits. Khajiit prices only seem high.
society.skycraft.say.traveler.caravan.1: From the south, over three passes. The guards at every gate ask what is in the crates. Khajiit says: sweetness.
society.skycraft.say.traveler.caravan.2: Khajiit sleeps by the road and sells by the road. Where would a roof be, when there is a buyer yonder?
Letters, letters. Do not stop me unless you are paying; the hold waits for none.
Make way, I carry the seal of a steward.
Quick one, then. The next hold is half a day's walk.
society.skycraft.say.traveler.courier.0: Every hold has its own news and none of it good. I only carry it; I do not read it.
society.skycraft.say.traveler.courier.1: Roads are bad by the river. Take the highway if you can, and keep to the stones.
society.skycraft.say.traveler.courier.2: The Jarls write more than ever since the dragons. I have worn through two pairs of boots.
Peace on your road, traveler. I walk to a shrine, and I walk slowly.
The Divines keep you. Do you need a blessing?
Forgive me, I was in prayer. Many miles still to go.
society.skycraft.say.traveler.pilgrim.0: I go to Kynareth's grove, then the temple at the end of the road. A vow I made when the old year ended.
society.skycraft.say.traveler.pilgrim.1: A pilgrim carries no coin, and so no one robs her. Only the wolves care, and they are unconvinced.
society.skycraft.say.traveler.pilgrim.2: There are shrines all along this road. Stop at each. They remember who passed by.
society.skycraft.greet.traveler.hunter.0: Quiet, if you please. The deer on this ridge are skittish.
society.skycraft.greet.traveler.hunter.1: Good morning. I would offer you rabbit, but I have not had luck.
society.skycraft.greet.traveler.hunter.2: Mind your step. A wolf pack crossed here at first light.
society.skycraft.say.traveler.hunter.0: Game has moved higher this year. The wolves push everything up the slopes.
society.skycraft.say.traveler.hunter.1: A good pelt buys a week's bread at the market. A bad one buys a lecture from the tanner.
society.skycraft.say.traveler.hunter.2: If you hear a horn up the pass, do not go that way. That is not a hunting call.
society.skycraft.greet.traveler.bard.0: A song for the road? I have three, and one of them is even mostly true.
society.skycraft.greet.traveler.bard.1: Do you hear that? That is the sound of my lute needing a new string.
society.skycraft.greet.traveler.bard.2: Well met. Tell me a story and I shall put it in a verse.
society.skycraft.say.traveler.bard.0: I play at the inns, between the towns, and I take what is thrown. Mostly bread, sometimes coin.
society.skycraft.say.traveler.bard.1: The best song I know is about a man who gave up on the road. It is very short.
society.skycraft.say.traveler.bard.2: They ask for the old songs and then argue about the words. I smile and change the verse.
society.skycraft.greet.traveler.soldiers: Move along, citizen. This road is under watch.
Halt. State your business, and keep your hands where we can see them.
Orders are orders. We walk this road until we are told to walk another.
society.skycraft.say.traveler.soldiers.0: We are to keep the road open. Not to fight, if we can help it. But we will.
society.skycraft.say.traveler.soldiers.1: Bandits at the crossing, a giant near the pass, and the Jarl wants a report by tonight.
society.skycraft.say.traveler.soldiers.2: If you see a camp of men with no banner, go around. That is not our trouble to take on, yet.
society.skycraft.greet.traveler.tinker.0: Pots mended, knives sharpened, kettles, needles, buttons! Day or night, friend, day or night!
society.skycraft.greet.traveler.tinker.1: Anything broken? I can bind it, weld it, or at least make it look better.
society.skycraft.greet.traveler.tinker.2: Here, take a look. A little of everything, and most of it works.
society.skycraft.say.traveler.tinker.0: The donkey is called Patience, because that is what it takes. We cover three holds a season.
society.skycraft.say.traveler.tinker.1: Townsfolk want a smith who is always at the forge. I go where the pots are cracked.
society.skycraft.say.traveler.tinker.2: I sell nothing the guard has not looked at. They like my spoons.
society.skycraft.greet.traveler.farmer.0: Whoa, easy. Mind the donkey, he is not fond of strangers.
society.skycraft.greet.traveler.farmer.1: On the way to market with what the frost left me.
society.skycraft.greet.traveler.farmer.2: Morning. If you are heading to town, the road is clear as far as the bridge.
society.skycraft.say.traveler.farmer.0: The Jarl's tax is the same, whatever the harvest. I have learned not to count the bad years aloud.
society.skycraft.say.traveler.farmer.1: Wheat sells, cabbages sell, goats do not. I could not tell you why.
society.skycraft.say.traveler.farmer.2: Trade by the roadside is not allowed in the walls, they say. So I wait until I am out of sight of the guards.
society.skycraft.greet.traveler.refugees: Please, friend. Is the next town far? We have walked all night.
We mean no trouble. We are only looking for somewhere safe.
Have you seen the road to the next hold? The children are tired.
society.skycraft.say.traveler.refugees.0: Our village burned. Dragon, they said. I do not know. I only saw the sky.
society.skycraft.say.traveler.refugees.1: We will find work, or kin, or a barn. We are not proud.
society.skycraft.say.traveler.refugees.2: The soldiers told us to keep to the road and not to stop. So we do not stop.
society.skycraft.greet.traveler.adventur: Looking for work, or looking for trouble? Same road, either way.
Hail. I would say the day is fine, but I have seen the sky over the mountain.
You have the look of someone who has been underground. Good. Then you will understand.
society.skycraft.say.traveler.adventurer: There is a barrow past the ridge with two doors and no way back. I am still deciding.
Gold is easy to find. Staying alive long enough to spend it, that is the difficult part.
If you find something with a glow and a hum, leave it. I speak from experience.
society.skycraft.greet.traveler.tax.0: Official business of the hold. Stand aside, please.
society.skycraft.greet.traveler.tax.1: The Jarl's tax is due. I shall remember you when it is.
society.skycraft.greet.traveler.tax.2: Do not look at the strongbox. The soldiers will notice.
society.skycraft.say.traveler.tax.0: Farms, mills, mines. Each owes its measure. I only write the number.
society.skycraft.say.traveler.tax.1: People are not fond of me. I would not be, either. But someone pays the guards.
society.skycraft.say.traveler.tax.2: My escort walks a pace behind. Not for my safety. For the safety of the figures.
society.skycraft.bark.role.trainer.0: Footwork first, steel second. Again, from the guard stance.
society.skycraft.bark.role.trainer.1: A master repeats the fundamentals ten thousand times before calling them simple.
society.skycraft.bark.role.trainer.2: Discipline outlasts raw strength in every fight I've seen.
society.skycraft.greet.trainer.0: Ready to put in the hours? Skill isn't bought, it's drilled into the bone.
society.skycraft.greet.trainer.1: Show me your stance, %s. Let's see what we have to work with.
society.skycraft.say.job.trainer: I instruct those with the coin and the patience to hone their craft properly. Most adventurers swing wild until someone teaches them form.
dialogue.skycraft.society.training_lore: How do you train your students?
dialogue.skycraft.society.context: How is life around here lately?
dialogue.skycraft.society.react: What do folk here make of my deeds?
society.skycraft.say.training_lore.0: Repetition under pressure. Anyone can strike a target dummy; the trick is keeping your balance when the dummy swings back.
society.skycraft.say.training_lore.1: I watch where your weight settles before you move. Fix the hesitation there and the rest follows.
society.skycraft.say.training_lore.2: Five lessons a season is all the body can absorb at once. After that, you have to take what you've learned out onto the road.
society.skycraft.train.at_cap: You have already reached this trainer's %1$s limit (%2$s).
society.skycraft.train.level_cap: You have already trained %1$s times at your current character level.
society.skycraft.say.train.done: Good. Your %1$s is sharper now—level %2$s. Keep practicing what we drilled today.
society.skycraft.say.train.at_cap: I've taught you everything I know of %1$s (cap %2$s). You'll need a higher master from here on.
society.skycraft.say.train.level_cap: You've already taken %1$s lessons at your current level. Go test yourself in the field before we drill again.
society.skycraft.say.train.no_gold: My time and materials aren't free, friend. Bring %1$s gold when you're ready to begin.
react.generic.dragon_slayer: Word travels fast along the high roads—they say a dragon fell before your blade, %1$s.
react.generic.companion_member: You carry yourself like one of Jorrvaskr's shield-siblings. Good steel and an honest arm are welcome here.
react.generic.college_member: A scholar of the northern College, are you? Mind where you cast your wards inside town walls.
react.generic.thieves_member: Folk with quiet boots and Riften's coin-marks tend to know every back door. Keep your hands off our ledgers.
react.generic.brotherhood_member: There is cold iron in your stare, traveler. Whispers of the Listener's hand follow you down the road.
react.generic.civil_war_hero: Veterans at the gate still recount how you turned the battle line when the banners clashed.
react.generic.high_bounty_cleared: Your name is struck from the watch-captain's slate at last. Walk straight and keep the peace.
react.generic.local_hero: Half the households in this settlement owe you a favor or a warm mug by the hearth.
react.generic.hold_story: Since you settled the trouble that plagued this hold, the watch sleeps with one eye closed instead of neither.
react.generic.bounty_hunter: Another notice torn from the bounty post and paid in full—bandits are starting to learn your stride.
react.generic.master_craftsman: You have the calluses of a true master artisan; even our guild-wrights speak of your work with respect.
react.generic.barrow_delver: You smell of old stone and tomb-draughts. Few walk out of the barrows carrying as much as you do.
react.whiterun.dragon_slayer: I stood on the western rampart when the sky cleared over the watchtower. Whiterun's plains owe their breath to you, %1$s.
react.whiterun.companion_member: Jorrvaskr's mead-hall rings louder since you took your place by the Skyforge.
react.whiterun.college_member: Farengar has been pacing Dragonsreach's porch hoping to compare notes with a fellow College arcanist.
react.whiterun.thieves_member: The caravan factors outside the main gate double-lock their strongboxes whenever a Riften shadow passes through.
react.whiterun.brotherhood_member: Even the wind off the tundra feels sharper when you cross the Wind District. Keep your contracts far from our hearths.
react.whiterun.civil_war_hero: The barricades around the plains still bear the marks of your stand for Whiterun's walls.
react.whiterun.high_bounty_cleared: Commander Caius finally crossed your tally off the barracks board. Try not to test his patience twice.
react.whiterun.local_hero: From the Gildergreen's terrace down to the market stalls, Whiterun calls you a true friend of the hold.
react.whiterun.hold_story: The western farms are planting again now that the watchtower road and the plains are secure.
react.whiterun.bounty_hunter: Proventus says you've cleared more bandit camps on the tundra than two full patrols of the guard.
react.whiterun.master_craftsman: Even Eorlund glances twice at the edge on your gear when you pass beneath the Skyforge.
react.whiterun.barrow_delver: Bleak Falls sits quiet above the river at last—every trader between Riverwood and the plains thanks you.
react.haafingar.dragon_slayer: From the great stone arch of Solitude to the docks below, sailors toast the one who brought a dragon down.
react.haafingar.companion_member: Castle Dour's drill sergeants respect Jorrvaskr steel, even if your hall takes no orders from generals.
react.haafingar.college_member: Sybille Stentor remarked that someone from Winterhold's towers with actual discipline is a rare sight at the Blue Palace.
react.haafingar.thieves_member: The East Empire warehouse clerks count their crates twice whenever you stroll along the Solitude piers.
react.haafingar.brotherhood_member: The Penitus Oculatus patrols keep glancing over their shoulders on the cobbles. You cast a long shadow in Haafingar.
react.haafingar.civil_war_hero: Castle Dour's war-room maps carry your victories across every pass in Skyrim.
react.haafingar.high_bounty_cleared: The High Court's magistrate sealed your pardon this morning. Walk the arch as a free citizen.
react.haafingar.local_hero: From the Bards College courtyard to the Fletcher's arch, Solitude welcomes you with open doors.
react.haafingar.hold_story: Wolfskull's dark rituals are broken, and the coast road past Dragon Bridge is calm once more.
react.haafingar.bounty_hunter: Falk Firebeard says the sea-caves along the northern cliffs haven't been this clear of raiders in ten winters.
react.haafingar.master_craftsman: Beirand says your hammer-work could outfit the Blue Palace's honour guard without a single flaw.
react.haafingar.barrow_delver: The coastal barrows above the Karth estuary no longer spill restless dead onto the king's highway.
react.eastmarch.dragon_slayer: To fell a wyrm in the snows of Eastmarch is a deed worthy of Ysgramor's old chronicles, %1$s.
react.eastmarch.companion_member: A shield-sibling of the Five Hundred's line always has a place by the braziers of Windhelm.
react.eastmarch.college_member: Folk on the stone bridge eye Winterhold robes warily, though Wuunferth claims you know your craft.
react.eastmarch.thieves_member: Even along the gray alleys by the docks, cutpurses step aside when one of Riften's inner circle walks past.
react.eastmarch.brotherhood_member: After the whispers around the Aretino house, no one in the Stone Quarter speaks your name above a murmur.
react.eastmarch.civil_war_hero: The long-tables at the Palace of the Kings raise their horns whenever your campaigns are named.
react.eastmarch.high_bounty_cleared: The Bloodworks jailer hung up his keys on your account; your debt to Eastmarch is paid in full.
react.eastmarch.local_hero: Both the market square and the dockside hostels speak of you as the steadiest hand in Windhelm.
react.eastmarch.hold_story: The frost-mists over the hot springs have settled since you ended the terror stalking Windhelm's streets.
react.eastmarch.bounty_hunter: Jorleif's bounty ledger is half empty thanks to you—the crag-bandits above Kynesgrove are in full retreat.
react.eastmarch.master_craftsman: Oengul says the heat of your forge-craft could rival the oldest anvils in the Palace quarter.
react.eastmarch.barrow_delver: The burial mounds along the White River sit silent again after your delving.
react.the_rift.dragon_slayer: The golden birches of the Rift trembled when that beast fell—even Lake Honrich's fishermen saw the smoke, %1$s.
react.the_rift.companion_member: A Companion in Riften? Honest muscle is scarce along the canal, and the merchants are glad of it.
react.the_rift.college_member: Wylandriah has been muttering about your arcane theorems between losing her spoons in Mistveil Keep.
react.the_rift.thieves_member: The canal guards know better than to ask what business brings you up from the Ratway steps.
react.the_rift.brotherhood_member: Even the toughest mercenaries at the Bee and Barb go quiet when you take a corner table.
react.the_rift.civil_war_hero: Whether in the autumn passes or the watchtowers around Shor's Stone, your banner-work is remembered.

society.skycraft.chat.gossip_gideon.0.2: Good thing too—without wetland rice, reed rafts, and Blackwood border trade, half the hearths around Imperial stone lower walls topped with Argonian stilt-galleries would go cold before next market day.

society.skycraft.chat.gossip_gideon.1.2: Let Imperialised Argonians, Colovian factor descendants, and marsh guides argue in Imperial stone lower walls topped with Argonian stilt-galleries—we still have to keep watch along broad silt levees and low clay islands along the Blackwood frontier.
society.skycraft.chat.gossip_gideon.2.0: The elders at weathered Imperial chapels standing beside living Hist sap-pools were speaking of the Second and Third Era legion campaigns that built the western causeway again this morning, %1$s.
society.skycraft.chat.gossip_gideon.2.1: In Gideon, nobody forgets the Second and Third Era legion campaigns that built the western causeway—every stone of broad silt levees and low clay islands along the Blackwood frontier still bears the mark.
society.skycraft.chat.gossip_gideon.2.2: True enough. Keeps a body humble when walking past weathered Imperial chapels standing beside living Hist sap-pools at dusk.

society.skycraft.chat.gossip_sea.3.2: If they wake what sleeps under uncharted abyssal plains and lone volcanic seamounts far from land, the guards of chartered East Empire navigators and independent high-seas captains won't be pleased.
society.skycraft.chat.gossip_sea.4.0: Have you seen the shrines of prayers to Kynareth and the constellations when the last headland drops below the horizon on the feast-day in lashed salvage rafts and lonely rock-stack beacons, %1$s?
society.skycraft.chat.gossip_sea.4.1: Every family in the High Seas brings offerings—even amid doldrum calms, scurvy rations, and ghost-ships drifting without crews, the old customs hold.
society.skycraft.chat.gossip_sea.4.2: It is the one thing chartered East Empire navigators and independent high-seas captains and the common folk still agree upon.
society.skycraft.chat.gossip_sea.5.0: The drovers crossing albatrosses, deep-sea kraken, and wandering serpent shoals say unbroken oceanic winds and towering grey swells came early to the High Seas this season, %1$s.
society.skycraft.chat.gossip_sea.5.1: Hard weather on uncharted abyssal plains and lone volcanic seamounts far from land always tests the caravans hauling long-range exploration carracks carrying salt pork, fresh water casks, and brass sextants.
society.skycraft.chat.gossip_sea.5.2: We'll keep the hearths lit in lashed salvage rafts and lonely rock-stack beacons until the skies clear over the great converging currents where the Eltheric, Padomaic, and Ghost seas meet.
society.skycraft.attitude.kin_welcome.0: Well met, kin. It warms the hearth to see one of our own walking these roads, %1.
society.skycraft.attitude.kin_welcome.1: Step inside and share the fire, %1. Blood and heritage still count for something here.
society.skycraft.attitude.kin_welcome.2: A friendly face of our own people! You are always welcome at our tables, %1.
society.skycraft.attitude.wary_outlander: Keep your hands in sight, outlander. Folk here do not warm quickly to strangers, %1.
Say what you need and move along, %1. We have enough trouble without outsiders stirring the pot.
You are a long way from home, outlander. Mind the local customs if you want fair dealing.
society.skycraft.attitude.trusted_outlan: You may not have been born to our blood, %1, but your deeds have earned our respect.
Any friend of our people is welcome at this counter, %1. You have proven your worth.
They speak well of you in the hall, %1. Outlander or not, you stand with us.
society.skycraft.attitude.ancestral_grud: Old blood is not forgotten here, %1. State your business quickly and keep your blade sheathed.
We remember the scars your people left on this land, %1. Expect no favors here.
The watch has its eye on you, %1. History between our peoples runs deep and bitter.
society.skycraft.attitude.heretic_suspec: Walk carefully, %1. Those who flout the sacred laws of this land find cold welcome here.
Our priests and wardens watch your steps, %1. Do not test the patience of the faithful.
Keep your heresies and foreign rites away from our shrines, %1.
society.skycraft.attitude.blood_kin_requ: Outlanders do not set foot in an Orc stronghold unless named Blood-Kin. Earn the Chief's trust or leave.
No trade and no shelter for strangers here, %1. Only Blood-Kin of the strongholds may deal with us.
By the Code of Malacath, this stronghold is closed to you until a chief names you Blood-Kin.
society.skycraft.attitude.cosmopolitan_n: Coin is coin at this counter, %1, no matter what road or province you hail from.
Every tongue and banner passes through this market sooner or later. Welcome, %1.
Safe travels, %1. In a crossroads town, we judge folk by their dealings, not their birthplace.
This garrison stands under Imperial law, %1. Watch your tongue if you harbor rebel sympathies.
The Legion keeps order on these streets, %1. Do not give the watch reason to question your loyalty.
Imperial courts do not look kindly on secessionists or trouble-stirrers, %1. Walk straight.
society.skycraft.attitude.imperial_suspe: You smell of Imperial coin and White-Gold treaties, %1. Speak plainly if you want to deal here.
We bow to no distant Emperor in this hold, %1. Remember whose banner flies over these walls.
Folk here have bled enough for Imperial decrees, %1. Keep your Legion talk to yourself.
scene.skycraft.wonder.t6_su_psijic_rift_: Psijic mystics of Ceporah Tower weave golden stasis-glyphs around a shimmering Old Ways time-rift.
scene.skycraft.wonder.t6_vw_spinner_stor: A Bosmer Spinner of Y'ffre chants the memory of rooted Falinesti as torchbugs weave through the giant graht-roots.
scene.skycraft.wonder.t6_bm_hist_sap_spe: Argonian Tree-Minders gather around bioluminescent Hist roots as amber sap-light pulses through the marsh mist.
